application.name: ofetch
application.summary: A TypeScript typed fetch wrapper that normalizes HTTP requests, responses, errors, retries, timeouts, and lifecycle hooks across browser and Node runtimes.
application.purpose: Provide a typed, convenient fetch client ($fetch/ofetch) that auto-handles JSON bodies, query/params, baseURL, response parsing, error normalization, retries, timeouts, hooks, and runtime-specific fetch adapters.

domains.name: Fetch core client
domains.description: Central request pipeline: resolves options, applies baseURL/query, executes fetch, parses the response, and returns _data or a FetchResponse.

domains.name: Request body handling
domains.description: Classifies payload methods, decides JSON serialization vs streams/FormData, sets JSON headers, and enables duplex streaming.

domains.name: Response parsing
domains.description: Detects response type from Content-Type and parses bodies into JSON, text, blob, arrayBuffer, or stream data.

domains.name: Error normalization
domains.description: Converts network/HTTP failures into a FetchError carrying request, options, response, data, status, and statusText.

domains.name: Retry and timeout
domains.description: Aborts on timeout, retries eligible response codes with configurable delay, and suppresses retrying aborted requests.

domains.name: Runtime adapters
domains.description: Chooses browser/global fetch versus Node fetch with optional keep-alive agents via node-fetch-native.

domains.name: Lifecycle hooks
domains.description: Runs onRequest, onRequestError, onResponse, and onResponseError hooks around the request lifecycle.

Response-like object with an _data field holding the parsed payload.
URL composition helpers used to build requests and merge default and per-call query/params.
Parser/mode for the response body: json, text, blob, arrayBuffer, or stream.
Automatic retry behavior for failed requests on selected status codes, with a delay that can be fixed or computed from context.
Lifecycle callbacks (onRequest, onRequestError, onResponse, onResponseError) executed before/after the fetch and response handling.

applicationFacts: Exposes both browser/global-fetch entry (src/index.ts) and Node-oriented entry (src/node.ts).

Runs a Promise-based fetch pipeline with context, onRequest hook, baseURL/query composition, JSON body handling, timeout abort, fetch execution, response body parsing, response/response-error hooks, and error normalization.
Auto-stringifies JSON-serializable bodies and sets application/json content-type/accept headers when absent.
Leaves non-JSON or stream/FormData/Buffer bodies alone, enabling duplex half streaming for ReadableStream/Node Readable bodies.
Detects content-type and parses JSON, text, blob, arrayBuffer, or stream responses, exposing parsed data as response._data.
Normalizes failures into FetchError with data, status/statusCode, statusText/statusMessage, request, options, and cause; supports ignoreResponseError.
Retries requests on default status codes (408, 409, 425, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504) or custom retryStatusCodes, with fixed or computed retryDelay, and does not retry active aborts.
Supports timeout via AbortController with TimeoutError cause and code 23.
Supports onRequest/onRequestError/onResponse/onResponseError hooks as single hooks or arrays; hooks run before failure handling.
Provides $fetch.raw for the full response, $fetch.native for the underlying fetch, and $fetch.create(defaults, globalOptions) to derive a child client with merged defaults.
Node entry uses globalThis.fetch when available, else node-fetch-native, with optional keep-alive agents controlled by FETCH_KEEP_ALIVE.
Builds with unbuild, emits declarations and CJS/ESM, externalizes undici, and builds src/index and src/node entries.
Tests use a local h3/listhen server to cover ok, params, baseURL, JSON post bodies, Buffer/stream/FormData bodies, errors, retry/delay, abort, timeout, hooks, and option merging.
